title: CombatListener
description: Prevents combat logging with cooldowns, action bar timer, command blocking and customizable combat rules.
body:
# ⚔ CombatListener
 Advanced Combat Logging System for Fair PvP

---

### 🔥 Fair PvP Starts Here

**CombatListener** is a lightweight yet powerful plugin that prevents combat logging and ensures fair fights.

When a player enters combat, they are tagged with a visible countdown.  
Logging out during combat results in **instant death** and **item drops**.

---

## ✨ Highlights

- ✔ Lightweight & Optimized  
- ✔ Fully Configurable  
- ✔ Zero Dependencies  
- ✔ Built for Paper 1.21+  

---

## 🔥 Features

### ⚔ Combat Tag System
- Players are tagged when they attack or get attacked  
- Action bar countdown (e.g. `Combat: 20s`)  

### 🚫 Anti Combat Logging
- Logging out during combat = **instant death**  
- Drops all inventory items  

### 🔊 Alerts & Feedback
- Sound plays when entering combat  
- Chat warning message  

### 🚫 Command Blocking
- Blocks **ALL commands** during combat (also OP commands btw)
- Prevents `/spawn`, `/home`, etc.

### 🧊 Movement Restrictions (Optional)
- Disable Elytra usage  
- Disable Riptide trident  
- Fully configurable  

### ⏳ Grace Period System
- Disable PvP temporarily  
- BossBar countdown display  
- Perfect for events & server start 
- /combatlistener graceperiod <seconds>
- /combatlistener stopgrace
